meta.title: Doubao brand test
meta.description: Drives a browser through BrowserSkill to ask Doubao five long-tail cosmetics questions six times each (30 total), record every reply, and check whether the answer recommends L'Oréal. The left-sidebar panel shows progress, hit rate, and replies, and exports CSV; the doubao_loreal_test agent tool exposes the same matrix and can resume a stopped JSONL run. Sign in to Doubao in the browser first.
